summary.walkthrough: This pull request introduces embedded semgrep rule presets for JavaScript, Python, and Ruby, allowing the scanner to use these rules without needing external configuration files. It also updates the semgrep scanner to use these embedded rules based on the languages present in the changed files.

change_groups.title: Add embedded semgrep rule presets
change_groups.summary: New files are added to embed semgrep rule presets for JavaScript, Python, and Ruby. These presets are curated to focus on high-signal security issues and are embedded as byte slices in Go code, allowing them to be used directly by the scanner without needing external configuration files.

change_groups.title: Update semgrep scanner to use embedded presets
change_groups.summary: The semgrep scanner is updated to use the embedded rule presets based on the languages detected in the changed files. It introduces logic to resolve which presets to use, creates temporary files for these presets, and cleans them up after use. Tests are added to ensure the correct presets are selected and used based on the file types in the changes.

summary.testing_notes: Run the semgrep scanner on a repository with JavaScript, Python, and Ruby files to ensure it correctly uses the embedded presets. Verify that the scanner skips Go files and respects the ZREVIEW_SEMGREP_CONFIG and ZREVIEW_DISABLE_SEMGREP_PRESETS environment variables.
summary.risk: low: The changes are self-contained to the semgrep scanner and introduce new functionality without altering existing behavior.
